description: Source code implementing UL-CCCH message handling for 5G NR RRC protocol, including message type selection, serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice type for UL-CCCH message, handling different message variants and serialization.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class managing specific message types within the choice, including serialization and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_ccch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the entire UL-CCCH message as a sequence, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'c1' and returns reference to nested class.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'message class extension'.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: set_rrc_setup_request
methods.description: Sets message to RRC setup request type.

methods.name: set_rrc_resume_request
methods.description: Sets message to RRC resume request type.

methods.name: set_rrc_reest_request
methods.description: Sets message to RRC re-establishment request type.

methods.name: set_rrc_sys_info_request
methods.description: Sets message to RRC system info request type.
